$comment: Single source of truth for the ZAI teacher Rive files and the app code that drives them. Rive artists/agents build to these exact names. App code (src/lib/avatar/contract.ts) is generated from or checked against this file. Bump `version` on any breaking rename.

Teacher.framing: half-body, waist up; top of head ~120 from top; waist cut at bottom edge

TeacherBust.framing: head and shoulders, for chat bubbles, notifications, dashboard

playGesture.note: App sets `gesture` then fires this. Re-firing restarts the gesture.

viseme.note: Integer mouth shape, see Viseme table. Updated up to 60x/s by app.

speaking.note: Adds talking beats on the body layer and enables mouth layer

listening.note: Lean-in loop, attentive eyes, nods scaled by voiceLevel

thinking.note: Waiting for AI reply: eyes up, small hmm loop. Hides latency.

reducedMotion.note: Halve secondary motion and gesture amplitude, no bouncing

parallaxX.note: App drives from pointer/gyro; layers shift by depth

celebrate.note: Scene-level flourish: lanterns sway, lights brighten for 1.5 s

ambience.note: Ambient loops (lantern sway, steam, birds, stars). Off when reducedMotion.

visemes.name: AA
visemes.examples: a in father, Mandarin a, Spanish a

visemes.name: EH
visemes.examples: e in bed, French è, Mandarin e (ê)

visemes.name: EE
visemes.examples: ee in see, i, y, Mandarin i

visemes.name: OH
visemes.examples: o in go, Spanish o, French o/ô

visemes.name: OO
visemes.examples: oo in food, u, w, Mandarin u and ü, French u

visemes.name: FV
visemes.examples: f, v (top teeth on lower lip)

visemes.name: CONS
visemes.examples: s, t, d, n, k, g, l, r, zh, ch, sh, x, j, q (teeth slightly open)

gesturePeak.fire: the expressive moment: hand reaches card (point_card), thumb fully up, wave apex, clap contact. App syncs UI to it (card launch, sparkle, sound).

traceStart.fire: fingertip begins following the tone path

toneTrace.$comment: The fingertip of the character's left hand (screen right) follows these paths with a Follow Path constraint. The app draws a glowing trail along the same path in sync with traceStart/traceEnd, so the path must match. Coordinates are normalized inside traceBox: x 0..1 left to right, y 0..1 top (high pitch) to bottom (low pitch).
toneTrace.pitchNote: Mandarin tone contours on the Chao 1-5 scale: t1 55, t2 35, t3 214, t4 51. y = 1 - (chao - 1) / 4, inset by 0.03 so the fingertip stays inside the box.

anchors.$comment: Artboard-space points the app uses to position UI next to the character. Agent confirms final values in the QA report.

budgets.lowEndDevice: 2019-era Android mid-range phone in Chrome, canvas renderer
